tools.name: regiai_get_balance
tools.description: Return the remaining RegiAI credit balance in USD for this API token.

tools.name: regiai_list_tools
tools.description: List every RegiAI tool (image, video, audio) with its inputs and price.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate a new image from a text prompt, or edit an input image with a prompt. $0.10 per image.

tools.name: upscale_image
tools.description: Increase image resolution and detail. $0.03 per image.

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Cut out the subject and return a transparent PNG. $0.10 per image.

tools.name: remove_watermark
tools.description: Remove watermarks, logos and overlaid text. $0.10 per image.

tools.name: restore_photo
tools.description: Repair scratches and damage in old photos. $0.10 per image.

tools.name: unblur_image
tools.description: Sharpen a blurry photo. $0.05 per image.

tools.name: face_swap
tools.description: Put the face from "image" onto the person in "target_image". $0.10 per swap.

tools.name: describe_image
tools.description: Get a detailed text description of an image. $0.01 per image.

tools.name: image_to_text
tools.description: Extract all readable text from an image. $0.01 per image.

tools.name: answer_picture_question
tools.description: Solve the math, physics or chemistry problem shown in an image. $0.01 per image.

tools.name: analyze_image
tools.description: Ask any question about an image, with an optional system prompt. $0.01 per call.

tools.name: ai_image_generator
tools.description: Text to image with 12 models. from $0.01. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_image_editor
tools.description: Edit photos with a prompt. $0.03 per image. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_clothes_changer
tools.description: Try on outfits virtually. $0.05 per try-on. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_head_swap
tools.description: Swap heads in photos. $0.10 per swap. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_face_editor
tools.description: Change facial expressions. $0.03 per image. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_image_expander
tools.description: Extend images with AI. $0.03 per image. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_photo_colorizer
tools.description: Colorize black & white photos. $0.03 per photo. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_selfie_generator
tools.description: Stylized selfies and avatars. $0.10 per image. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_anime_filter
tools.description: Turn photos into anime. $0.03 per image. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: multiple_face_swap
tools.description: Swap several faces in one photo. $0.35 per photo. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_body_swap
tools.description: Put yourself in any body and outfit. $0.10 per swap. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_outfit_changer
tools.description: Change outfits with a prompt. $0.10 per image. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_dress_changer
tools.description: Try on dresses in one click. $0.10 per image. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: braces_filter
tools.description: See yourself with braces. $0.10 per image. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_couple_photo_generator
tools.description: Make couple photos from two selfies. $0.10 per photo. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_video_generator
tools.description: Text and image to video. from $0.50. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_talking_photo
tools.description: Make photos talk. $0.40 per 100 characters. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_lip_sync
tools.description: Sync lips to any audio. $0.35 per video (up to 10s). Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_face_swap_video
tools.description: Swap faces in videos. $0.75 per video (up to 10s). Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: gif_face_swap
tools.description: Swap faces in GIFs. $0.75 per GIF (up to 10s). Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: image_to_video
tools.description: Animate any photo. from $0.50. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: text_to_video
tools.description: Turn a prompt into a video. from $0.50. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_character_replace
tools.description: Replace characters in videos. from $0.75. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_video_restyle
tools.description: Restyle videos with a prompt. from $0.60. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_video_upscaler
tools.description: Upscale videos to 1080p. $0.80 per video (up to 10s, 1080p). Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_subtitle_generator
tools.description: Generate SRT subtitles. $0.10 per video. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_video_to_audio
tools.description: Add sound to silent videos. $0.05 per video. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_video_extender
tools.description: Make clips longer. $1.50 per extension (+6s). Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_video_colorizer
tools.description: Colorize old videos. $0.10 per video (up to 30s). Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_voice_generator
tools.description: Text to natural speech. $0.15 per 1,000 characters (min $0.05). Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_voice_cloner
tools.description: Clone a voice from a sample. $0.10 per 1,000 characters. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_music_generator
tools.description: Songs from a prompt. $0.40 per song. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_voice_changer
tools.description: Change a voice in any recording. $0.05 per recording. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_audio_translator
tools.description: Dub speech into 18 languages. $0.09 per second (min $0.50). Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_speech_to_text
tools.description: Transcribe audio to text. $0.05 per file. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_sound_effects
tools.description: Sound effects from text. $0.05 per sound. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: ai_vocal_remover
tools.description: Separate vocals and music. $0.10 per song. Runs asynchronously: returns a generation_id; call get_generation until status is "completed".

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Check the status of a generation started by any asynchronous RegiAI tool. Returns output_url (or output_text) once status is "completed".
